purpose: Pins the exact field-proven ARIEC61850 acquisition/control engine lineage from 11ab2304482600c19ba979f4fc9021ddb46b9af9, plus the P0 Legacy SAS export extension that preserves exact runtime RCB identities, preserves the existing single-RCB behavior, and allows several operator-selected ReportControls/DataSets to be retained in one CID. Includes a regression test for separate Analog and Digital DataSets. Acquisition, reporting activation, DataSet planning, control and FAT live-value behavior are otherwise unchanged.
